Privacy Policy

All tools on Tooldeck process data on your device. Files, text and generated values are never sent to our servers.

We do not use advertising trackers. Our host may keep standard server logs (such as IP address and pages requested) for security and reliability.

Optional payments are processed by Stripe under Stripe's privacy policy. We never see your full card details.
